_comment: What any monster beaten drops while a quest asks for it (Managers/QuestFightDrops), which no
table of the client's carries. A row: the item, its chance in percent per monster beaten (raised
by challenges, the Almanax and the server's drop bonus like any other drop) and the criterion it
drops under, read as the monsters' loot is (Qa = quest in hand).
«Reír a base de palos» (1198): the hazelnut Lotape is on 138 dungeon bosses' own tables («Qa=1198»,
about 5 %); the other five flavours «se dropent sur tous types de monstres si la quête est
activée» (Dofus pour les noobs, Du rire en barre) and are on none. Their chance is INFERRED: the
bosses' 5 %, per flavour and per monster.

drops.why: Lotape de caramelo: off any monster while «Reír a base de palos» is in hand («Caramel/Fraise/Citron/Orange/Kola: se dropent sur tous types de monstres si la quête est activée»); never once it is done («Une fois la quête terminée, vous ne pourrez plus drop de Rabmarac»).
